ui.role: All UI, navigation, labels, buttons, vocabulary, kanji, grammar, flashcards, quizzes and settings.
ui.note: Only genuine static 400 and 700 files were present in the source distribution; no synthetic 500/600 font files were created.

reading.role: Reading passages, stories, articles and long-form Japanese text.
reading.note: Only genuine Regular 400 is packaged for Reading; a Serif bold file was omitted to keep the reading font subset compact.

loading.readingFont: load when Reader/Reading view needs it
loading.serviceWorker: precache font assets in a future integration phase; service worker not changed here

coverage.supportedScope: Supplied V19.0 corpus + V19.1 wireframe + sample text only
coverage.futureContent: Regenerate Japanese core/extended subsets for new content outside the audited codepoint set.

assetStrategy.japanese-core: Full hiragana/katakana blocks, JP punctuation and audited kanji index
assetStrategy.japanese-extended: Additional Japanese codepoints in the audited content outside the 801-entry index and kana/punctuation blocks
assetStrategy.symbols: Additional source symbols supported by the font cmap; unsupported pictographs use platform fallback

integration: Documentation/reference only; no application HTML, CSS, JS, manifest or service worker changed.
